description: This Java class defines a DialogFragment for selecting a time via a TimePicker UI component, creating and saving an alarm based on user input, and notifying listeners about the newly added alarm.

classes.name: TimePickerFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment that presents a TimePicker for the user to select a time, then creates and stores an Alarm based on the selected time.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of TimePickerFragment.

methods.name: setAlarmAddListener
methods.description: Sets the listener to be notified when an alarm is added.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and sets its style.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes AlarmStorage and AlarmUtil after activity creation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes UI components, and sets click listeners for buttons.
